[kṛtīśvarajiṣṇu]
[father of Dāmodara (a. of Ārogyacintāmaṇi. Bikaner 3940)]. Mistake for Viṣṇu Bhaṭṭa. [Page272-b]

[kṛtyaratnākara]
[by Lakṣmīdhara. Peters. I. Extr. p. 108]. Mistake for Kṛtyakalpataru.

[kṛlikopaniṣad]
Mu7nchen 184 (p. 107).
Mistake for Cūlīkoº, northern recension of Mauktikopaniṣad (southern); ptd. a. 34th in N. S. Press edn. of 120 Up.., 1948.
See also Adyar Up. p.. 181. 242.

[kṛṣṇakavi]
--Mahiṣaśataka.
[Pt.. with C. in Telugu script, Madras, 1875. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1538. A.'s name mistake for Kuṭṭi Kavi alias Vāñcheśvara Yajvan].

[kṛṣṇa_kavi]
[--Muktācaritra. Hpr. IV. 219. Author mistake for Raghunāthadāsa].

[kṛṣṇakelikā,_kṛ._kālikāpraśna]
[jy. by Bhaṭṭotpala. Allahabad 172. IM. 1140].
Is this a mistake for a.'s Praśnakalikā ?

[kṛṣṇacarita]
ascribed to Samudragupta.
[Pt.. Gondal, Kathiawad.] Apocryphal.
On this see A. D. Pusalkar, J. Bomb. Uni. XXII. ii. p.. 36-44; ABORI. XXVI. p.. 313-18; D. H. H. Ingalls, JAOS. 85. i. (1965), p.. 60-5.

[kṛṣṇaprabandha]
[MD. 12743 (inc.). MT. 7132 (inc.). (restored from above)].
Same a. Kṛ. dūta or Dūtavākya of Melpputtūr Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa.

[Kṛṣṇodanta]
[kāvya. TCD. 1441E (inc.)]. Trav. Uni. C. 2300E (inc.). Same a. Vāsudevacarita.
See TCD. 1524.
